Not yet. The 2025 loss is a detected candidate, but it is neither confirmed nor shown to be persistent.

- **What is observed:** Hansen/UMD maps about 13.5 ha of tree-cover loss in 2025, about 3.9% of the 345.6 ha asset. The JRC 2020 map agrees that 98% of that area was forest in 2020. The MGAP 2021 map shows it was mostly native forest (13.1 ha), with no planted forest.
- **Why persistence is unconfirmed:** 2025 is the latest year in the series, and no later year has been observed for this event. The corroboration rule requires a later year, so the status is "pending corroboration." The JRC agreement meets only one of the two conditions.

This also does not establish deforestation or land-use change, the cause, legality, or who was responsible. Hansen loss includes any stand replacement.

Persistence can only be checked once 2026 data is available.
